head.title: Talk to a human
head.body: Our dedicated customer care team is available by phone, text and email.

channels.title: Taking out a new loan?
channels.note: Please include your full name when emailing.

channels.title: Struggling with repayments?
channels.note: If you’re in difficulty, reach out — ignoring the problem only makes it worse.

channels.title: Update details or settle your loan?
channels.note: For settlements, include your full name and ‘SETTLEMENT’ in your message.

debtAdviceHtml: You can always seek free, independent and impartial debt advice from StepChange (0800 138 1111) or MoneyHelper (0800 138 7777).
